versions.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation
v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release of the Completion Report Generator.

- Automatically aggregates daily task results and generates completion reports at 23:00 via cron.
- Summarizes 30-day performance for returning users and generates WelcomeBackCard with pending tasks and improvement suggestions.
- Provides tenant-level completion rate statistics, including Jain fairness index calculation.
- Handles exceptions for database connectivity, missing data, and aggregation timeouts.
- Supports outputs for both scheduled reports and 30-day user summaries.
